Character averaging and exact period-six identities prove the quotient formula for every n>=3. Finite tests are secondary to the unbounded argument.

originality.rationale: Targeted actual published-finding corpus searches and accessible own claim/title ledger found no same wheel ordinary matching D_n character. Full text of most plausibly covering published-finding corpus results was retrieved and compared: the cycle matching result is a proper spoke-free component, the wheel Morse complex is a different incidence-arrow object, and Vega 2019/2021 covers only nonequivariant wheel topology. The new character and quotient residues are not implied by the cited ranks; unindexed equivariant work remains a risk.

value.rationale: Wheel graphs are canonical planar nonouterplanar families with known nonequivariant sphere wedges. Complete dihedral characters distinguish genuinely different rotation/reflection actions hidden by Betti ranks, exhibit equality of two nonconjugate reflection trace classes, and determine a nontrivial periodic (mod12) quotient homology phenomenon with explicit four congruence classes. This is a motivated, unbounded equivariant classification, not a routine numerical increment.
